label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: y hija del yaana, y el tahmás y el shahaf y el nets a su especie,
spanish: y hija de la yaana, y el tahmás y el shahaf y el nets a su especie,
grammarChanges: Changed "del yaana" to "de la yaana" so the article agrees with the feminine noun (morph Td/Ncfsa for הַיַּעֲנָה); the masculine "del" was a grammar mismatch, not a translation choice.
readerNote: hold: lexical gloss — tahmás, shahaf, nets, and yaana stay as untranslated transliterations because the packet gives only Hebrew morphology (no Spanish gloss for H8464, H7828, H5322, H3284), and supplying the species names would require memory or outside sources, which Pulir is forbidden to use.
